dedupe_keys.name: ifcnet benchmark dataset for ifc entity classification

description: IFCNet is a benchmark dataset of single-entity IFC files spanning a broad range of IFC classes, with both geometric and semantic information, built by the Institute of Energy Efficiency and Sustainable Building (E3D) at RWTH Aachen University. It was presented at the EG-ICE workshop in June 2021 to support machine learning that enriches BIM models semantically, since training needs large and datasets. The project page offers the original IFCNet and a curated IFCNetCore as IFC files, IFCNetCore geometries as OBJ, and pre-converted versions for MVCNN (PNG views), MeshNet (NPZ) and DGCNN (PLY), plus code on GitHub and pre-trained MVCNN, MeshNet and DGCNN models. In the paper's experiments, using geometry alone, three deep learning models reach good classification performance. Coverage: generic building elements, not tied to a place. Licence: none was stated for the dataset on the project page or in the paper (the preprint carries the arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence), so check before reuse; free download. Caveats: the files are single objects such as a wall or a door, not whole buildings, so it tests element classification, not model-wide analysis. Useful for digital twin and BIM workflows that need element types; it relates to the IFC Industry Foundation Classes record in the catalogue.
